notes.title: Bug Bait Demo feature update!
notes.notes:
Hello!! 
We hope you have been enjoying the first demo of Bug Bait! We have had plenty of feedback from you all about our game and we are extremely grateful and look foward to giving you the best experience we can!

Recently, we have been working on polishing, updating and fixing issues that were discovered by you and us, along with introducing new features to the game as well! 
Some of the new features include:
[list]
[*]Minimap
[*]Wave rushing
[*]Ambient animations
[/list]
And improved existing features:
[list]
[*]UI Health bar polish
[*]Enemy pathfinding revamp
[*]Resource balancing
[*]Minor wave tweaking
[*] Environmental assets
[/list]
Do you enjoy these changes or hate them? (We hope not hate.) Be sure to join our Discord and give us your feedback on the game! What do you think should be added or changed about bug bait?

Some small tweaks and patches will be released over the next few weeks, and some major updates are planned for after the next fest!! So stay tuned and enjoy the game :)

Discord: https://discord.gg/QHTkmN3x3h
